newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Castrate gays, Zimbabwe campaigner says.
newsitem.headline: Castrate gays, Zimbabwe campaigner says.

text.p: A former Zimbabwean nationalist leader has launched a campaign to persuade anti-gay President Robert Mugabe's government to punish homosexuality with castration and public whipping.

The crusade, calling for public lynching and castration of convicted rapists and gays, began a week after police said they were investigating charges of homosexual rape against former president Canaan Banana.

"These crimes are on the increase and Zimbabwean laws against sexual perverts, especially rapists and gays, are too soft," Michael Mawema, a former nationalist politician, told the first meeting of his campaign on Tuesday night.
About 100 people turned up to hear him say Christianity and Zimbabwe's old black culture were unequivocally against "these perverts".

"I am proposing that those convicted of these sexual crimes, such as homosexuality, rape, incest and bestiality, be whipped at least 100 times in a public square, and that if they are men be castrated," he said.

Zimbabwe outlaws sodomy, the charge used to convict homosexuals. Mugabe has led public attacks on gays, saying they are worse than dogs and pigs, but has remained silent over allegations that his predecessor Banana forced a male bodyguard to have sex with him repeatedly.
Banana, 61, a Methodist church minister who was president until 1987, has not commented on the charges against him, which a court judge ruled were "probably true".
Mawema said the current maximum penalty of seven years for sex crimes was too lenient.

Mike Auret, director of one of Zimbabwe's leading human rights watchdogs, the Catholic Commission for Justice and Peace, said Mawema was wrong to advocate the use of old biblical law that regards homosexuality as a sin worthy of death.
"We must do something to curb rape, child abuse and bestiality, but gay is a different class," he said.
Mawema also said the law must punish witch doctors who are alleged to prescribe rape, incest or child abuse to cure some sexual diseases, including AIDS, or to secure businesss success.
